name: @s2script/addonmanager
description: Mounts Steam Workshop addons on the server
author: s2script

addons_extra.description: Workshop addons to download, mount on the server and send to every client, in load order, separated by commas or spaces (MultiAddonManager's mm_extra_addons).

addons_client_extra.description: Workshop addons only clients load, separated by commas or spaces (mm_client_extra_addons).

addons_extra_timeout.description: Seconds a client has to reconnect after being sent away for an extra addon, for that addon to count as downloaded (mm_extra_addons_timeout).

addons_connection_timeout.description: Seconds a client may stay on its first addon download before it is dropped; 0 never drops (mm_addon_connection_timeout).

addons_mount_download.description: Ask Steam for an update every time an addon is mounted, even when it is installed (mm_addon_mount_download).

addons_cache_clients.description: Remember which addons each client has, so map changes and rejoins skip the reconnects (mm_cache_clients_with_addons).

addons_cache_duration.description: Seconds a remembered list lasts after the client was last seen; 0 is forever (mm_cache_clients_duration).

addons_block_disconnect_messages.description: Hide the "loop shutdown" disconnect message players see when someone reconnects for an addon (mm_block_disconnect_messages).
